title: Title & Registration Services Rate Card: Vehicle Program Relief on a Fee-Shortage Cure Payment
content:
Kestrel relieves part of a Title & Registration Services buyer's fee-shortage cure payment for the vehicle program on the purchase order. The program is the one shown on the purchase order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements.

| Vehicle program on the purchase order | Relief |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Premium Certified | one tenth (0.10) |
| Kestrel Factory Certified | one tenth (0.10) |
| Kestrel Certified | one twentieth (0.05) |
| Kestrel Certified Plus | one twentieth (0.05) |
| any other program (Kestrel Value Line, Kestrel Inspected) | nothing |

The relief is a fraction of the cure payment as it stands before any relief is taken off, and that fraction of it is taken off the payment. The result is rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

## Rate card examples (hypothetical cure payments before relief)

| Program | Cure payment before relief | Relief taken off | Payment after this relief |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Factory Certified | 60.00 | 6.00 | 54.00 |
| Kestrel Certified Plus | 60.00 | 3.00 | 57.00 |
| Kestrel Inspected | 60.00 | 0.00 | 60.00 |
